newsitem.title: CHINA: China wants more power firms to list overseas.
newsitem.headline: China wants more power firms to list overseas.

text.p: China will allow more electric power firms to list shares and issue debt abroad, the China Economic Times said on Wednesday.
China is also considering letting power firms form shareholding companies overseas or set up investment funds, the newspaper quoted Shi Dazhen, Minister of Power Industry, as saying.
He did not give any details of power sector companies that would be given permission to raise funds offshore.
Chinese power firms listed on foreign markets include the Huaneng International Power Co, the Shandong Huaneng Power Development Co and the Beijing Datang Power Generation Co.
Power companies should also try harder to obtain loans from domestic commercial banks as the availability of low-interest policy credit was limited, he said. No further details were given.
